items.title: Relive: Keegan's Newcastle lose thriller to Liverpool
items.description: BBC Sport looks back at one of the Premier League's best ever games as Newcastle, then managed by Kevin Keegan, lost a thriller to Liverpool. Both clubs will pay tribute to Keegan before their Premier League opener at St James' Park.

items.title: How Arsenal 'punished' newly promoted Coventry
items.description: Match of the Day's Mark Chapman, Alan Shearer and Wayne Rooney discuss Arsenal's quality against Coventry City, praising the hosts but stressing that Frank Lampard's side shouldn't be judged.

items.title: Why Spurs' defeat to Brentford is 'worrying' after summer signings
items.description: Match of the Day's Mark Chapman, Alan Shearer and Wayne Rooney discuss how Tottenham Hotspur's heavy loss to Brentford is cause for concern considering how much money they have spent.

items.title: How the 'new boys' of Ipswich got their season off to a dream start
items.description: Match of the Day's Wayne Rooney is full of praise for Ipswich Town on their return to the Premier League as they earn a late victory over Sunderland.

items.title: 'They just didn't look fit at all' - Shearer on Man Utd
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Alan Shearer and Wayne Rooney analyse Manchester United's performance in their 2-0 loss on the opening day of the Premier League to newly promoted Hull City.

items.title: Man City latest: Maresca: Man City need to find a new Rodri
De Zerbi admits 'we're not a team yet' as Redknapp labels Spurs 'strangers'
items.description: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi believes their dismal 3-0 opening-season defeat at Brentford shows his new-look side are "not a team yet" after a big summer of spending.

items.title: Papers: Arsenal pair Arteta and Berta in 'frequent contact' with Alvarez
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Sunday's newspapers...

items.title: Olise stars as Bayern beat Dortmund to win Supercup
items.description: Bayern Munich beat Borussia Dortmund 2-1 to retain the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup at Signal Iduna Park.

items.title: Man City will 'try to find the new Rodri' - Maresca
items.description: Manchester City will "try to find the new Rodri" after the Spain captain left the club earlier this week to join La Liga champions Barcelona, says manager Enzo Maresca.

items.title: We let fans down, says Nuno after West Ham defeat
items.description: Nuno Espirito Santo says West Ham "let down" their fans as they lost 2-1 to Charlton in their first Championship home match this season.

items.title: Alvarez open to Arsenal transfer - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Atletico Madrid forward Julian Alvarez open to Arsenal transfer, Spurs confident on completing Omar Marmoush deal, Ollie Watkins wants Al-Hilal move, plus more.
